description: This script generates C++ header and source files for ANGLE format mapping, including enums and format info tables, based on JSON data and format mappings.

methods.name: ceil_int
methods.description: Calculates the ceiling of value divided by mod.

methods.name: is_depth_stencil
methods.description: Checks if an angle_format specifies depth or stencil channels.

methods.name: get_component_suffix
methods.description: Returns suffix based on component type.

methods.name: get_channel_struct
methods.description: Generates a string representing the channel structure of a format.

methods.name: get_mip_generation_function
methods.description: Returns mip generation function name based on format.

methods.name: get_color_read_write_component_type
methods.description: Maps component type to C++ type.

methods.name: get_named_component_type
methods.description: Maps component type string to GLenum constant.

methods.name: get_component_alignment_mask
methods.description: Calculates alignment mask based on channels and bits.

methods.name: get_vertex_attrib_type
methods.description: Determines vertex attribute type from format id.

methods.name: json_to_table_data
methods.description: Converts format JSON data to C++ table entry string.

methods.name: parse_angle_format_table
methods.description: Generates format table data for all formats.

methods.name: gen_enum_string
methods.description: Generates enum string for format IDs.

methods.name: gen_map_switch_string
methods.description: Generates switch-case string for format mapping.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script entry point for generating C++ files.
